title: kotobaya daemon state, v1
description: One full state per NDJSON line. Never a delta. Card text fields appear once the server sends QueueItem.text (ARCH-CARD-TEXT), and back/reading/sentence only after reveal; until then card has only id, kind, revealed and previews.

conn.description: server_too_old (ADR-037): the server sends no review loop; no cards, counts null, notice says so.

counts.description: Deprecated (ADR-037): the server's legacy counts (learning includes cards due later). Use phase/ready/later_today/new_today.

kind_label.description: Note type of the card in English title case (Vocab, Kanji, Grammar, Phrase, Sentence, Custom). Omitted when the server did not send the note.

state.description: FSRS state of the card (Card.state); new = never reviewed. Omitted by older daemons.

keep_going.description: C-26/C-27: keep going is on for this daemon run (past today's limits until a keep-going fetch is empty).

more_available.description: Deprecated (ADR-037; use phase). C-26: the server's more_available of the last fetch: done under today's limits, keep going has more.

can_keep_going.description: Deprecated: phase in goal_reached/done_for_today, no card shown, keep going not on.

loading.description: A refresh or keep-going refetch is running in the background; reveal and answer still work.

next_due_at.description: ADR-033: with no card shown, the UTC instant the next learning card falls due today (the daemon refetches then); null otherwise. Only in phase waiting (C4: the one timer).

phase.description: ADR-037 loop phase of the last response; null until loaded or while not conn ok.

ready.description: Ready now = ready learning + ready reviews (new cards excluded).

until_stop.description: ADR-054: cards doable now (learning + review + new, never later). The number widgets show. Null from an older server or while not conn ok.

later_next_due_at.description: UTC instant of the earliest of those; null when none.

backlog.description: Due reviews regardless of the review limit.

until_stop_parts.description: ADR-049: until_stop split into the four numbers the web header shows (learning + later + review + new = until_stop). Null from an older server or while not conn ok; widgets then fall back to counts.
